column3: FLORINIA: This will install to your Pokégear, and will read data output from the machine we encountered before.
Intelligence has revealed the machine is called the Pokémon Ultimation Link System Exaggeratta, or simply "PULSE" for short.
This speaker has already entered the data obtained regarding the previously-engaged Tangrowth, but any future subjects must be added separately.
Analogous to the Field Notes app, the PULSE Dex is capable of alerting you when within the presence of a machine whose data has been recorded.
If any inquiries about the afflicted Pokémon emerge, press D in battle to access its associated data.
It may be possible to find data print-outs for each machine in an area near their application, so remain watchful.

BENNETT: ...Which is why it's important to have a thorough understanding of checks and threats to common win conditions.
Many beginning Trainers favor a hyper-offensive style focusing solely on offensive moves and type coverage,
But this approach to team-building is focused on the naive generalization of types themselves as the primary determinants of battle.
We are not battling against types; we are battling against Pokémon.
Putting the focus on win conditions and countering specific checks is the reason that even mono and duo themed teams are able to prevail.
